bead.title: Emit release-grade hybrid-async evidence and close ACs
bead.description:
PROBLEM: Once the harness, gates, and hot-path fix land, the release-grade evidence must actually be produced and committed under docs/perf so the parent verification succeeds; the current state is only the smoke row plus a blocker log.
ROOT CAUSE: docs/perf/evidence/performance_object_log_hybrid_release_10m.blocker.log records that the 10M lane was never run because the hot-path gate failed (claim/finalize p95 1.610x); emit_ledger at crates/pqueue-server/tests/performance_object_log_hybrid_tests.rs:531 writes the JSONL row, and the TP-002 summary docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md still describes objectlog/hybrid-strict rather than the hybrid-async release lane.
PROPOSED FIX: run the full release matrix (10k/100k/1M/10M where capacity permits, warm/cold, concurrency/batch sweeps, >=5 reps) with all gates active; write the per-scale JSONL ledgers under docs/perf/evidence and docs/perf/evidence/hybrid-scale; refresh docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md (or a hybrid-async successor doc) to record the closed 10k gaps (ack 2.836x->=1.20, claim/finalize 33.359x->=1.20), the variance/outlier policy, and the bounded-debt/segment-density/object-PUT/attribution gates; remove or supersede the blocker log. Every emitted row must carry bars_met true.
NON-SCOPE: authoring new harness, gate, attribution, or fix logic (other children); release version bump.
DEPENDS ON: children 'Hybrid-async perf harness', 'Hybrid-async perf gates + profile attribution', and 'Close hybrid-async hot-path gap'.
GATE SUBSTITUTION: `cargo test -p pqueue-server` is the test gate; `cargo fmt --check` is the pre-commit gate.
bead.acceptance:
1. `PQUEUE_LEDGER_DIR=docs/perf/evidence cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_smoke -- --nocapture` passes and emits bars_met true.
2. `PQUEUE_LEDGER_DIR=docs/perf/evidence/hybrid-scale PQUEUE_PERF_ENV=1 PQUEUE_HYBRID_RESIDENT=10000 cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_release_10m -- --ignored --nocapture` passes.
3. `rg -n 'bars_met.*true|hybrid_ack_p99_vs_inmemory_ratio|hybrid_claim_finalize_p95_vs_inmemory_ratio' docs/perf/evidence docs/perf` succeeds.
4. The prior blocker log docs/perf/evidence/performance_object_log_hybrid_release_10m.blocker.log is removed or superseded by a passing release-tier JSONL, and docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md documents the closed 10k ack (2.836x) and claim/finalize (33.359x) gaps now <=1.20.
5. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
